name: toggle-group
useFor: Use ToggleGroup for a set of related toggles: type="single" (the default) for one choice that changes a view in place, type="multiple" for filters that combine. Use variant="outline" for filter rows and icon toolbars. To switch between panels of content use Tabs.
constraints: Separate floating keys in the default variant
A chosen key that grows or bolds
source: The Hoplite website's pricing period switch (.pr-period, .pr-period__option) and changelog filter (.cl-filter, .cl-filter__option)
title: Toggle group
description: Segmented toggles: an outlined hexagon holding compact hexagons with the chosen one filled ink (the pricing period switch), or joined square boxes with the chosen ones filled ink (the changelog filter).
